title: Civic-issue GeoJSON Feature -- universal base
description: Every contributed Feature, in any theme, in any PC, must satisfy this. Theme-specific structured fields (schema/themes/<theme>.schema.json) are additional, not a replacement for this.

name.description: Short human-readable label for this feature (place/site name).

theme.description: Must match the theme file's own name (e.g. 'water' in water.geojson) and be a snake_case id.

claim.description: One-line plain-English statement of the claim. Keep it short -- structured fields carry the detail.

status_tag.description: Must be one of the values already defined for this theme in the PC's theme_colors.json. A genuinely new tag requires adding it there in the same PR, with a color -- never invent one silently.

confidence.description: Your honest assessment of how solid the claim is. A contributor's self-rating is a starting point, not the final word -- the reviewer can adjust it.

geometry_basis.description: surveyed = geometry comes from a real, checkable boundary source (official shapefile, OSM admin relation, etc.) -- must be independently verifiable, not just asserted. approximate = hand-drawn polygon, must render visibly different (dashed) from a real one. point = a single representative location, not a boundary claim at all.

_source.description: Where the CLAIM comes from -- a document, article, dataset, or 'Field observation by <name>, <date>' if there is no external document. Distinct from _contributed_by (who submitted it to this system).

_source_url.description: A link to _source. If there truly is no URL (e.g. a phone conversation), use a value like 'no URL -- see _note' and explain in _note.

_fetched_at.description: ISO date/datetime this feature was produced (not necessarily when the underlying source was published).

_status.description: Every newly contributed feature must be 'needs_verification' unless the reviewer has independently corroborated it at merge time. Never self-certify 'ok'.

_note.description: Optional. Use for caveats: why geometry_basis isn't 'surveyed', name-collision risk, anything a reader should know before trusting this.

_contributed_by.description: Who submitted this to the system (GitHub username + PR/issue link), stamped by the reviewer at merge time -- not something a contributor sets on themselves.

_extracted_by.description: Optional. If this claim came from mining a larger source document (not the same person who found the document), who did the extraction.
